تكتنفين (form VIII)
# تَكْتَنِفِينَ (taktanifīna) /tak.ta.ni.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# تُكْتَنَفِينَ (tuktanafīna) /tuk.ta.na.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
